description: Register an outbound webhook: MisarPost will POST signed payloads for the chosen events to this URL from now on. The response carries the signing secret exactly once — tell the user to store it; it cannot be shown again. Sending account data to a new URL needs the user's explicit approval of that URL.

events.description: Events to deliver: post.published, post.failed, account.disconnected.

url.description: The user's public HTTPS endpoint (max 2048 characters).
